title: Finite local metric models for residually finite isometric actions
author: Vadim Alekseev, Andreas Thom
work: On finite local approximations of isometric actions of residually finite groups
difficulty_reason: The author proof constructs a finite metric action for arbitrary prescribed finite orbit data of a residually finite group. Its decisive step is not residual finiteness alone: adding epsilon times the discrete metric gives a positive lower bound on each nontrivial edge, which bounds the length of every putative shortening path in the finite quotient. Choosing the quotient injective on the corresponding finite word ball then lifts that path back to the original invariant metric, where the triangle inequality rules out the shortcut. This gives the required uniform distance approximation and a finite isometric action. The proof itself supplies the metric construction and no-shortcut mechanism; it does not obtain the theorem by invoking an existing finite-approximation result.
